_about: How profile item level is built from its parts. Every value has a source and a confidence: confirmed = checked against the game's own item level (nkls, 2,540, Oct 26 2026: model 2,534, 6 unexplained), inferred = from guides or a reasonable guess, unknown = placeholder. NCSOFT's API grades are Common / Rare / Legend / Unique (Legend is what guides call Epic / blue).

base.source: API /api/character/equipment/item `level` (86, 70, 65 …) — sums to the game value

enchant.source: reconciliation; Fubgun / JOHNPAL: +1 per enhancement level

amplification.source: JOHNPAL TV, Fubgun (“every +1 Amp = +5 ilvl”); not yet seen in API data (exceedLevel 0)

stone.source: API magicStoneStat[].grade + reconciliation; matches Fubgun (white 1, green 2, blue 3) and JOHNPAL (gold 4)
stone.socketsSource: user notes; the API sends magicStoneSlotCount per item, which is used whenever present

arcana.source: API item.level of Arcana cards is 60 (Legend) / 80 (Unique); 20/40 from JOHNPAL TV (inferred)
arcana.maxLevelSource: API maxEnchantLevel (Legend 4, Unique 5 confirmed; Common/Rare from user notes)

daevanion.source: API /api/character/daevanion/detail node grades (github.com/nuriland/aion2-api); aion2-guides.info: grey 1, green 2, blue 3, orange 4; sums to the game value
